## What's Changed

- Moves Tater Tube Players into a full-width responsive row at the bottom of the dashboard, so a large player collection no longer stretches Active Streams.
- Matches playback activity to the unique paired-device ID instead of a shared display name.
- Keeps identically named players separate when grouping streams, viewing activity, and stopping playback.
- Adds a short device identifier to each dashboard player card so unnamed players are easy to tell apart.

## Upgrade

Pull the latest container and restart:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/tatertotterson/tater-tube-server:latest
docker restart tater-tube-server
```

No configuration migration is required.
